+import csv
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+con.execute("CREATE VIEW crashes AS SELECT crash_date, number_of_motorists_killed FROM read_parquet(?)", [str(DATA)])
+
+# Check the date filter before applying it, then check year populations and
+# outcome-field missingness inside the planned 2013-2025 years. No outcomes
+# are summed or counted by value in this data-quality step.
+source_rows, missing_dates = con.execute(
+    "SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date IS NULL) FROM crashes"
+).fetchone()
+year_rows = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, count(*) AS rows,
+           min(crash_date) AS first_date, max(crash_date) AS last_date,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_motorists_killed IS NULL) AS missing_motorist_deaths
+    FROM crashes
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).fetchall()
+
+facts = [
+    ("source_rows_checked_for_crash_date_filter", source_rows),
+    ("source_rows_with_missing_crash_date_excluded_from_year_grouping", missing_dates),
+]
+observed = {row[0]: row for row in year_rows}
+for year in range(2013, 2026):
+    if year not in observed:
+        facts.extend([
+            (f"rows_in_{year}_population_before_outcome_missingness", 0),
+            (f"{year}_date_coverage", "no dated rows"),
+            (f"missing_number_of_motorists_killed_in_{year}_population", 0),
+        ])
+        continue
+    _, count, first_date, last_date, missing_outcome = observed[year]
+    partial = first_date.year > year or (first_date.year == year and (first_date.month, first_date.day) > (1, 1))
+    partial = partial or last_date.year < year or (last_date.year == year and (last_date.month, last_date.day) < (12, 31))
+    facts.extend([
+        (f"rows_in_{year}_population_before_outcome_missingness", count),
+        (f"{year}_date_coverage", f"{first_date} through {last_date}; {'partial' if partial else 'full calendar-year endpoints observed'}"),
+        (f"missing_number_of_motorists_killed_in_{year}_population", missing_outcome),
+    ])
+
+for plan_id in (1, 2):
+    path = OUT / f"check_{plan_id}.csv"
+    with path.open("w", newline="") as f:
+        writer = csv.writer(f)
+        writer.writerow(["fact", "value"])
+        writer.writerows(facts)
*** End Patch

+import csv
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+data_path = str(DATA).replace("'", "''")
+con = duckdb.connect()
+
+annual = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           sum(number_of_motorist_killed) AS motorists_killed,
+           count(*) AS crash_records,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_motorist_killed > 0) AS crashes_with_motorist_death
+    FROM read_parquet('{data_path}')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).fetchall()
+
+# Framing 1: annual deaths count (no exposure denominator).
+values_1 = OUT / "values_1.csv"
+with values_1.open("w", newline="") as f:
+    writer = csv.writer(f)
+    writer.writerow(["year", "motorists_killed", "crash_records"])
+    writer.writerows((year, killed, crashes) for year, killed, crashes, _ in annual)
+
+years = [row[0] for row in annual]
+deaths = [row[1] for row in annual]
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+ax.plot(years, deaths, marker="o", linewidth=2, color="#2a6f97")
+ax.set_title("Motorists killed in NYC police-reported crashes, by crash year", pad=28)
+ax.text(
+    0.5, 1.015,
+    "Annual count, 2013–2025; not per-mile risk (vehicle-miles traveled unavailable)",
+    transform=ax.transAxes, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9,
